html: † [צְדָד] n.pr.loc. on N. border of Canaan, c. ה loc., צְדָ֫דָה Nu 34:8 (Σαραδακ, Sam. צרדה), Ez 47:15 (Σελδαμμα), read prob. צְדָ֫דָה; perhaps Khirbet Ṣerādā, N. of Abil, E. of Merj ʿAjûn toward Hermon (lat. c. 33° 25’ N., long. c. 35° 35’ E.), so van Kasteren Rev.Bibl., 1895, 30, cf. BuhlGeogr. 67.
